title: New Backend Update

sections.name: Accounts and subscriptions
items: Added Better Auth account endpoints backed by PostgreSQL.
Added Polar checkout, customer portal, and signed subscription webhook support.
Subscription changes now reconcile Brava access without affecting owner or admin licenses.

sections.name: Persistent licensing
items: Added PostgreSQL storage for license keys and device activations.
Added safe startup migrations and an optional guarded legacy JSON license import.
Device activation limits are enforced atomically by the database.

sections.name: Deployment reliability
items: Health checks now report storage, database, authentication, and billing readiness.
The API validates production secrets and completes migrations before accepting traffic.

instructions: This backend update deploys automatically. No desktop download is required.
